answer: Use SybilLimit's random routes. First, every agent keeps a secret shuffled routing table over its attestation links, a fixed kernel that never changes. Second, a newcomer sends 30 walks of 10 hops and registers the last edge of each. Third, a verifier accepts it only if one of those tails meets its own. Fourth, fakes are cut like marble from one quarry: their walks all exit through the same few attack edges, so each edge admits about 10 sybils. Getting 1,000 in means 100 honest links, roughly 3 months and $400 of real work apiece. Like a sonnet, the form caps how much you can cram in.
